name: print-social-cobalt-and-orange-architecture-post-grid
title: Cobalt and orange building posts with arcs, photos and bold sans
whatItIs: A 3x3 grid of posts in deep blue with orange curved swooshes and building photos in tilted or arch crops. Headlines are bold white sans with orange highlights and a script phrase 'New Memory'.
whatItMeans: Confident and constructive; blue-orange contrast feels dynamic and trustworthy.
techniques: Use big orange arcs to cut across blue cards.
Crop architecture photos into arches and diagonal panels.
Mix bold sans headlines with one script phrase.
bestFor: Service posts using blue and orange

vocabulary.definition: A wide curved band crossing a layout.
A photo masked with a rounded top.
Orange used against blue for contrast.
A short script insert in a sans headline.
